About Our Client
Wellness Equity Alliance is a national multidisciplinary health organization focused on addressing health inequities through integrated, community-based care. The organization delivers medical care, behavioral health services, substance use treatment, harm reduction, and care coordination through mobile and field-based models in settings such as schools, rural communities, reentry sites, and community-based locations.

The Patient Care Coordinator
conducts telephonic outreach to prospective CalAIM members, connecting eligible individuals with Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Supports programs. This fully remote position focuses on patient engagement, program education, eligibility screening, and enrollment coordination while supporting improved access to community-based care.

• Explain Enhanced Care Management, Community Supports, and other available services.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and web-based applications.

jobs.description:

Department: Department of Psychiatry

Job Title: Healthcare Entry to Intermediate Professional (Care Coordinator)

Position #:

Job Summary:

The PROMISE Clinic, an integrated behavioral health program that supports pregnant and postpartum patients as part of their prenatal care at UCHealth Anschutz, has an opening for a full-time Care Coordinator (Healthcare Entry to Intermediate Professional). This position primarily supports patients experiencing mental health symptoms by improving access to care and coordinating services through referral management, appointment scheduling, patient outreach, and assistance navigating PROMISE and other behavioral health services. The Care Coordinator also supports essential program operations, including maintaining patient and referral data, developing relationships with referring providers, and assisting with clinical data collection and reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as a primary point of contact for PROMISE patients, supporting referrals, scheduling, forms, resources, and access to services.
Manage referrals from receipt through scheduling and connection with care, including follow-up with patients and referring providers.
Provide patients with PROMISE and community resource information and schedule and reschedule appointments in Epic and conduct outreach regarding referrals, missed visits, and incomplete paperwork.
Document referral and care-coordination encounters in accordance with program and institutional requirements.
Maintain patient confidentiality and promptly route clinical questions, safety concerns, medication questions, and treatment requests to licensed clinicians.
Maintain relationships with referral sources and support outreach to referring practices and community partners, accurate referral, census, scheduling, and care-coordination data in Epic, REDCap, Excel, and other approved systems.
Track key patient and program metrics, including census, six-month postpartum status, and patients needing clinician review for discharge and collect and compile clinical and program data for grant reporting, productivity, evaluation, quality improvement, and planning.
Work with program leaders, providers, and staff to support daily operations and process improvement and provide administrative and operational support for PROMISE program activities and team functions.

Work Location:

Onsite – this role is expected to work onsite and is located in Aurora, CO.

Why Join Us:

The University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus is a world-class medical destination at the forefront of transformative science, medicine, education and patient care. The campus encompasses the University of Colorado health professional schools, more than 60 centers and institutes, and two nationally ranked independent hospitals - UCHealth University of Colorado Hospital and Children's Hospital Colorado - that treat more than two million adult and pediatric patients each year. Innovative, interconnected and highly collaborative, the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus delivers life-changing treatments, patient care and professional training and conducts world-renowned research fueled by over $650 million in research grants. For more information, visit www.cuanschutz.edu.

The Department of Psychiatry is one of the largest units in the UCD-SOM and is comprised of 5 Divisions. The CU Department of Psychiatry sets the standard for Education and Training of leaders in psychiatry and mental health care, conducts ground-breaking Research that aims to eradicate suffering due to psychiatric and substance use disorders, provides ready access to state of-the-art mental health preventions and interventions across the continuum of care, and collaborates with the community and other key stakeholders to promote well-being among all Coloradans. We accomplish this vision in a manner that respects, values and advocates for the dignity and worth of each individual and family.

The PROMISE Clinic is an integrated behavioral health program at UCHealth Anschutz that supports pregnant and postpartum patients as part of their prenatal and postpartum care. PROMISE provides timely access to behavioral health services through close collaboration among patients, obstetric providers, and mental health providers. The program focuses on identifying mental health needs, connecting patients with appropriate services and resources, coordinating referrals and follow-up, and supporting continuity of care throughout the perinatal period. PROMISE serves a diverse, high-needs patient population, including individuals facing complex behavioral health, medical, social, and access-to-care challenges during pregnancy and the postpartum period.

Schedule:

:

High School Diploma or GED required.

The ideal candidate should have a minimum of two-years work experience in a client facing position.

Strong computer literacy required.

Able to excel in a fast-paced, often high-stress, ever-changing environment.  

Treat animals and people with respect and employ humane handling techniques whenever possible. 

Must be able to lift and move up to 50 lbs.

We also have on-the-job training for 2-4 weeks, periodic all staff trainings to include safety, DEI, cross training, and other growth opportunities. 

Because ACC is a nonprofit, employees may be eligible for loan forgiveness, cancellation, and/or consolidation under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program (PSLF). Please use this link for more details on our benefits package.

Essential Job Functions
:

Provide support to foster volunteers to ensure all their needs are being met. This includes answering questions, providing support for behavioral issues, following up with medical concerns, and handling other issues that may arise.

Coordinate transportation of foster animals to foster volunteers, between care centers, and to adoption events.

Coordinate with Veterinary Services to ensure foster animals leave the care center with appropriate vaccines and treatment plans, schedule follow-up vet appointments, and assist with handling animals when appropriate.

Other Responsibilities
:

Assist in identifying appropriate foster animals for off-site adoption, outreach, and media opportunities. 

Coordinate logistics for foster animals attending events including scheduling behavior assessments, medical, and transport.

Assist Foster Supervisor with management of foster volunteer database.

Secure appropriate photographs of animals for foster and events.

Recruit new foster volunteers through orientations, interviews, and training.

Lead Open Foster Hours, identify appropriate foster animals to new fosters. 

Fear Free certification within 30 days of hire. 

Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

Preferred Qualifications
:

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Prior experience with Microsoft Office Suite preferred.

Prior experience with animals (dogs/cats/rabbits), either paid or volunteer, is strongly preferred but not required.

Bi-lingual (Spanish) preferred but not required.

Customer-driven and focused on providing a positive, upbeat, experience for all clients. 

High attention to detail, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive while working in busy environment. 

Work well independently but also function seamlessly as a member of a team.

At ACC it's all hands-on deck. We work together as a team, which means you may be asked to help with tasks that involve working outside in all sorts of weather. As a busy animal shelter in one of the biggest cities in the world it can get noisy inside. Employees should have the ability to remain calm yet professional in stressful situations involving animals and/or members of the public. ACC houses hundreds of animals in its facilities at any given time and with that comes fur, odors and other airborne particles in abundance. 

ACC offers many low-cost services to pets and people in need. This includes compassionate end-of-life services for people who cannot afford to go to a private veterinary office but still want to provide a professional and peaceful transition for their beloved pet. 

Training will take place at our Manhattan Centers. Employees will report there until the Bronx location is fully operational.

Foster Supervisor

Identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies and interface risks; escalate and resolve issues quickly to protect timeline and deal value.
Build and maintain executive steering committee materials, giving leadership decision-ready visibility into risk, progress, and open items at every stage of the deal lifecycle.

Division Transformation

Program-manage the end-to-end lifecycle of division-level change, including new division creation, division splits, division consolidations, and the introduction of sub-divisions within existing divisions.
Partner with Finance, HR, IT, and Land/Operations leadership to design future-state org structures, reporting lines, systems access, and data alignment ahead of go-live.
Lead business readiness activities — stakeholder communications, training, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization support — to minimize disruption to associates and ongoing operations.
Coordinate technology and license/consumption realignment as part of division change, connecting this work back to the Application Rationalization and License/Consumption Optimization workstreams owned by the team.

Executive Governance & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a credible partner to Lennar's senior leadership, translating complex, multi-workstream program activity — across both Strategic Initiatives and M&A/Division work — into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
Communicate proactively and transparently with stakeholders across Finance, Legal, Technology, HR, and Operations, ensuring alignment on scope, timeline, risk, and decisions at every level.
Influence outcomes and drive resolution across teams and vendors where no formal authority exists, using data, relationships, and clear framing to move decisions forward.

Develop and deliver executive status reporting, KPI tracking, and performance metrics that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.
Apply formal change control and stage-gated delivery discipline across hybrid Agile/Waterfall environments, adapting method to the needs of each initiative rather than a single rigid framework.
Partner with Internal Audit, Legal, and Compliance as needed to ensure programs meet regulatory, contractual, and financial reporting obligations.

Cross-Functional & Vendor Partnership

Manage relationships with external advisors, implementation partners, and vendors supporting Strategic Initiatives and M&A/Division Transformation work, holding them accountable to scope, timeline, and quality commitments.
Partner with enterprise PMO and other strategic initiative leads to ensure consistent methodology, shared learnings, and coordinated resourcing across concurrent programs.

Demonstrated ability to build and operate formal governance structures (RACI, steering committees, stage-gate change control) in complex, matrixed environments.

Experience with tools such as Smartsheet, GitHub, Power BI, ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, and Excel/PowerPoint for program tracking and executive reporting.
